text: Web: a pasted invite message with text around the link should still redeem (Android does since T-300)

Merged (HEAD 5d22e748), full gate green: web pastedInvite + shared-test-cases/invite-paste.json read by both clients; Android's pastedInvite moved to :core and now stops a link at a Unicode space like the web.

Gate: the first run's Android stage died with a native SIGSEGV in the bundled SQLite (Gradle test executor exit 134) unrelated to this change; the rerun of the same stage on the same tree is green (739 debug tests), the other five stages had passed. Flake filed separately.
